title: Kidney Tumor Study Klinikum Region Hannover
summary:
The operations on renal tumors are performend, depending on the localisation and size of the tumor and medical history, as an open surgery or keyhole surgery (laparoscopic or robotic assisted).
The Klinikum Region Hannover (KRH) GmbH has three urologic departments (Siloah, Großburgwedel, Gehrden) which have an high level expertise in operations of renal tumors.
The aim of the study is to examine the outcome of the operated patient with renal cancer in the departments of urology in the KRH GmbH. 
The data of the study will improve the treatment of the patients with operation on rencal cell cancer.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of kidney, except renal pelvis

interventions.name: all patient, which are operated on renal cell cancer in the urologic departments of the KRH GmbH

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- histopathologic proof of renal cell cancer
- existing of mri/ct-scan imaging
- surgery at urologic department of Klinikum Region Hannover
- consent of partipitation for the study
Exclusion criteria:
- hereditary or aquired bleeding tendency
- anatomic anomaly which prevent standard approach
sponsor: Abteilung für Urologie am KRH Klinikum Siloah
